risk_summary: The excerpt is relatively transparent and strongly quantified, with detailed revenue, margin, expense, and EBITDA comparisons. Risk tone is mildly negative because of slowing growth, European sovereign-debt exposure, currency sensitivity, pricing pressure, and client delays, although management offsets this with promotional and forward-looking language. Extensive MD&A boilerplate, non-GAAP emphasis, and some broad strategic claims modestly reduce disclosure clarity.
